title: Deleted YouTube feed items still appear in the all-items route
reasoning: The YouTube feed list hides soft-deleted feeds, and the per-feed items route rejects deleted feeds through _ensure_feed_exists. However, GET /youtube/items/all only filters MediaItem.content_type and does not join or otherwise check the parent MediaFeed.deleted_at state. After a feed is soft-deleted, its existing YouTube items can still be returned by the global all-items endpoint, making deletion behavior inconsistent and exposing items from feeds the API otherwise treats as gone.
reproduction: Create a YouTube feed with at least one MediaItem, delete the feed through DELETE /youtube/{feed_id}, then call GET /youtube/items/all. The item remains eligible because the query only filters MediaItem.content_type == "youtube".
recommendation: Filter the all-items query to items whose parent MediaFeed is not soft-deleted, for example by joining MediaFeed on media_feed_id and adding MediaFeed.deleted_at == None plus the YouTube feed type constraint if appropriate.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided, and there is no route-specific evidence covering the soft-delete case for GET /youtube/items/all.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an API test that creates a YouTube feed and item, soft-deletes the feed, then asserts GET /youtube/items/all does not return that item while active-feed items still appear in status/date order.
minimumFixScope: Update list_all_youtube_items in app/api/media.py and add a focused route test for deleted parent feeds.
